author: evidence-v3-repair-lane
role: Versioned replacement for evidence.v2; closes independent reviewer-10 findings without mutating historical artifacts.

schemaLanguage.rule: Every object/array node uses a named closed schema. Every field/element has an exact type, enum/pattern/range and deterministic outcome. Inline anonymous object/array schemas are forbidden.
schemaLanguage.totality: Every successfully parsed JSON root/value/path returns findings; no caller-controlled type may raise.

invariants.assert: Activated evaluation keys are unique before commitment; memberIds exactly equals the canonical activated set.
Outcome/claim/proof is an exact tagged union; relationship proof uses closed ordered WitnessEdges with full fact refs and anchors.
proofObligationId is host-derived from predicateId + claimShape + exact Coverage identity.
No-match resolves canonical partition/Coverage/predicate bytes and derives exact subject domain, count and completeness.
Universe/outcome/verdict commitments consume evaluation-proof.v2's injective grammar and pure policy.
Storage admission is fully resolved before durable evidence.
CAS-derived dependency edges and proof refs equal Phase1A's canonical minimum-capability closure.
Replay objects are non-empty unique full refs, CAS-resolved, one-unit-owned and AVAILABLE.
Closed CAS maps each full ContentRef to one exact canonical retained byte sequence and recomputes SHA-256.
Exact historical predicate/policy verifier artifacts consume VERSIONING v3 and fail closed when unavailable/unsupported.
sealedCapability is immutable and distinct; retention-tiers.v7 alone derives effectiveCapability from unit states.
